title: Enrollment
overview: This guide covers enrollment workflows for Super Admin.

subtasks.title: Add a New Practice
subtasks.purpose: Provision a new practice and its first admin in one form.

steps.title: Fill Practice Details
steps.description: Fill Practice Detail: name, type, status, tax ID, email, address.

steps.title: Fill Admin Details
steps.description: Fill Admin Detail: first/last name, email, phone, username, password (meeting criteria), 2FA toggle.

steps.title: Choose Email Preferences
steps.description: Under Practice Settings, choose Email Notification preferences.

steps.title: Set Billing Cycle Dates
steps.description: Under Care Program Billing Cycles, set RPM and CCM start date, billing cycle length (days), and end date.

subtasks.title: Configure Practice Settings
subtasks.purpose: Turn on transactional email notifications for the practice.

subtasks.title: Configure Care Program Billing Cycles
subtasks.purpose: The Admins module is the master list of every organisation-level administrator on the platform. From here the Super Admin can inspect coverage (how many practices each admin oversees) and add new admins.
